about: House recipes, batch 04 (slice C): written by Claude in a Max-plan session, original, ai-draft. Nutrition is a per-serve estimate kept as data only.

recipes.title: Indian Rava Idli with Cashews
recipes.summary: Soft steamed semolina cakes with cashews, mustard seed and curry leaf, ready without any fermenting.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves, cashews, chilli and ginger for 2 minutes, until the cashews turn golden.
Stir in the semolina and toast for 3 minutes, until fragrant, then cool.
Mix in the yoghurt, water and salt to a thick batter and rest for 10 minutes.
Stir in the bicarbonate of soda and spoon into greased idli moulds.
Steam for 12 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
notes: Serve hot with coconut chutney and sambar.
Makes about 12 idli.

recipes.title: Indian Rava Dosa Crisp Semolina Crepes
recipes.summary: Lacy, crisp restaurant-style crepes of semolina, rice flour and plain flour with cumin, pepper and cashews.
steps: Whisk the semolina, rice flour, plain flour, yoghurt, water and salt into a very thin batter and rest for 15 minutes.
Stir in the cumin, pepper, chilli, cashews, onion and curry leaves.
Heat a flat pan until very hot and pour the batter from a height in a lacy pattern to cover the pan.
Drizzle with oil and cook for 3 minutes, until the underside is crisp and golden, then fold and serve.
notes: Stir the batter before each dosa as the semolina settles.
Makes about 8 rava dosa.

recipes.title: Indian Spinach and Chickpea Flour Pancakes
recipes.summary: Quick savoury chickpea-flour pancakes with spinach, onion, green chilli and spices.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, water, turmeric, cumin, chilli powder and salt into a smooth batter.
Stir in the spinach, onion, chilli and coriander.
Pour a ladleful onto a hot oiled pan and spread into a thin round.
Cook for 2 minutes, until the underside is golden, then flip and cook for 2 minutes, until set and speckled brown.
notes: Serve with mint chutney or yoghurt.
Makes about 8 chilla.

recipes.title: Indian Instant Rava Uttapam with Onion and Tomato
recipes.summary: Thick, soft semolina and yoghurt pancakes with onion, tomato, chilli and coriander, with no fermenting.
steps: Mix the semolina, yoghurt, water and salt and rest for 15 minutes, until thick.
Stir in the bicarbonate of soda.
Pour a ladleful onto a hot oiled pan, spreading into a 12cm round, then scatter over the onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Drizzle oil around the edge and cook for 3 minutes, until the underside is golden.
Flip and cook for 2 minutes, until the topping is tender and the centre is cooked through.
notes: Makes about 6 uttapam.
Serve with coconut chutney.

recipes.title: Indian Kanda Poha Maharashtrian Flattened Rice
recipes.summary: A fluffy, turmeric-yellow breakfast of flattened rice, onion, peanut and curry leaf with lemon and coriander.
steps: Rinse the poha in a sieve until just soft, then drain and sprinkle with the salt, sugar and turmeric.
Heat the oil, fry the mustard seeds and peanuts for 2 minutes, until the seeds pop and the peanuts are golden.
Add the curry leaves, chillies, onion and potato and cook for 6 minutes, until the potato is tender.
Fold in the poha and cook for 3 minutes, until heated through.
Finish with the lemon juice and coriander.
notes: Serve with sev and a wedge of lemon.
Do not over-rinse the poha or it turns mushy.

recipes.title: Indian Egg Bhurji with Green Chilli
recipes.summary: Spiced scrambled eggs with onion, tomato, green chilli and turmeric, scooped up with toast or paratha.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the cumin for 30 seconds, until it sizzles.
Add the onion and chilli and cook for 4 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the tomato, turmeric and garam masala and cook for 3 minutes, until pulpy.
Whisk the eggs with the salt, pour in and stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set.
Scatter over the coriander and serve at once.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set with no runny egg.
Serve with buttered toast or paratha.

recipes.title: Indian Lemon Rice with Peanuts
recipes.summary: A bright South Indian rice dish tempered with mustard seed, peanut and curry leaf and finished with lemon.
steps: Cook the rice, drain and spread out to cool for 10 minutes, until the grains are dry and separate.
Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds and peanuts for 2 minutes, until the seeds pop and the peanuts are golden.
Add the dried chillies, curry leaves, green chilli and turmeric and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Fold in the rice and salt and heat for 3 minutes, until hot.
Finish with the lemon juice and coriander.
notes: Serve with yoghurt and papad.
Cooked rice should be cooled quickly and not left out for long.

recipes.title: Indian Masoor Sambar with Pumpkin and Beans
recipes.summary: A tangy South Indian lentil and vegetable stew with tamarind, pumpkin and green beans.
steps: Cook the lentils with the water and turmeric for 20 minutes, until completely soft, then mash.
Add the tamarind, beans, pumpkin, tomato, onion, coriander, cumin and chilli powder and simmer for 15 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and chillies for 1 minute, until the seeds pop.
Pour the tempering into the sambar and stir in the salt.
notes: Serve with idli, dosa or rice.
Thin with hot water if it thickens as it stands.

recipes.title: Indian Tomato Rasam
recipes.summary: A thin, peppery, sour South Indian soup of tomato, tamarind and garlic with cumin and mustard tempering.
steps: Simmer the tomato, tamarind, water, turmeric and salt for 10 minutes, until the tomato is soft.
Mash and add the garlic, 1 tsp cumin and the pepper, then simmer for 5 minutes.
Heat the ghee and fry the mustard seeds, remaining cumin, curry leaves and chillies for 1 minute, until the seeds pop.
Pour the tempering into the rasam and top with the coriander.
notes: Serve in small cups as a soup or over rice.
Do not boil hard after adding the tempering.

recipes.title: Indian Gujarati Kadhi
recipes.summary: A silky, lightly sweet and sour yoghurt soup thickened with chickpea flour and tempered with cumin and curry leaf.
steps: Whisk the yoghurt, chickpea flour and water until smooth.
Pour into a pot with the ginger, chillies, sugar, salt and turmeric and simmer over low heat for 15 minutes, stirring, until it thickens slightly.
Heat the ghee and fry the cumin, mustard seeds, curry leaves and dried chillies for 1 minute, until the seeds pop.
Pour the tempering over the kadhi.
notes: Stir constantly at first so the yoghurt does not split.
Serve with steamed rice and khichdi.

recipes.title: Indian Dhokla Steamed Chickpea Cake
recipes.summary: A light, springy, tangy Gujarati steamed cake of chickpea flour, with a mustard and sesame tempering.
steps: Whisk the chickpea flour, yoghurt and water into a smooth batter, then stir in the ginger, chilli, turmeric, salt and sugar and rest for 10 minutes.
Pour into a greased 20cm tin and stir in the fruit salt just before steaming.
Steam for 18 minutes, until a skewer comes out clean.
Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and sesame for 1 minute, until the seeds pop.
Pour over the dhokla, cut into squares and top with coriander.
notes: Serve warm with green chutney.
Steam as soon as the fruit salt goes in.

recipes.title: Indian Thepla Fenugreek Flatbread
recipes.summary: Soft Gujarati flatbreads of wholemeal flour, fresh fenugreek and yoghurt that keep well for travelling.
steps: Mix the flour, fenugreek, yoghurt, spices, sugar, salt and 1 tbsp oil.
Add the water bit by bit and knead for 5 minutes into a soft dough, then rest it for 15 minutes.
Divide into 10 balls and roll each into a thin round.
Cook each on a hot pan for 1 minute per side, brushing with the rest of the oil, until brown spots appear.
notes: Serve with pickle and yoghurt.
Keep in a covered container for up to 2 days.

recipes.title: Indian Aloo Paratha Breakfast
recipes.summary: Wholemeal flatbreads stuffed with spiced mashed potato and pan-fried in ghee until golden.
steps: Knead the flour, water and a pinch of salt into a soft dough and rest for 15 minutes.
Mix the potato, chilli, cumin, garam masala, chilli powder, coriander and the rest of the salt.
Roll a ball of dough into a small round, add 2 tbsp filling, seal like a purse and roll out gently.
Cook on a hot pan for 2 minutes per side with a little ghee, until golden with brown spots.
notes: Serve with yoghurt, butter and pickle.
Makes 6 parathas.

recipes.title: Indian Semiya Upma Vermicelli Breakfast
recipes.summary: A quick South Indian breakfast of toasted vermicelli with mustard seed, onion, peas and curry leaf.

items: 250g rice vermicelli, broken into short lengths

steps: Dry-roast the vermicelli in a pan for 4 minutes, until lightly golden, then set aside.
Heat the oil and fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves and cashews for 2 minutes, until the seeds pop.
Add the onion, chilli and carrot and cook for 5 minutes, until soft.
Add the water, peas and salt, bring to the boil until bubbling, then stir in the vermicelli.
Cover and cook for 4 minutes, until the vermicelli is tender and the water is absorbed.
Finish with the lemon juice.
notes: Serve with coconut chutney.
Do not over-stir or the vermicelli turns sticky.

recipes.title: Indian Bisi Bele Bath
recipes.summary: Karnataka's spiced rice and lentil one-pot with vegetables, tamarind and a ghee tempering.
steps: Cook the rice, dal, turmeric and water for 20 minutes, until both are very soft and mushy.
Add the beans, carrot, peas, tamarind, spice powder and salt and simmer for 12 minutes, until the vegetables are tender.
Heat the ghee and fry the mustard seeds, curry leaves, chillies and cashews for 2 minutes, until the cashews are golden.
Stir the tempering into the rice and loosen with hot water to a porridge-like consistency.
notes: Serve with boondi, papad and yoghurt.
Thin with hot water if it thickens.

recipes.title: Indian Tomato Onion Chutney
recipes.summary: A tangy, spicy South Indian chutney of slow-cooked tomato and onion with tamarind and chilli, ideal with dosa.
steps: Heat 1 tbsp oil and fry the mustard seeds and curry leaves for 1 minute, until the seeds pop, then set aside.
Fry the onion, chillies and garlic in the rest of the oil for 6 minutes, until golden.
Add the tomato, tamarind and salt and cook for 8 minutes, until pulpy and the oil separates.
Blend to a coarse chutney and stir in the tempering.
notes: Keeps in the fridge for 4 days.
Serve with idli, dosa or uttapam.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Appam Hoppers
recipes.summary: Lacy, bowl-shaped fermented rice and coconut pancakes with a soft centre and crisp edge.
steps: Mix the yeast, sugar and 100ml warm water and leave for 10 minutes, until frothy.
Mix with the rice flour, coconut milk, remaining water and salt to a thin batter and rest for 4 hours, until bubbly.
Heat a small hopper pan, grease with a little oil and pour in a ladleful of batter, then swirl to coat the sides.
Cover and cook for 3 minutes over medium heat, until the edges are crisp and the centre is set.
notes: Makes about 8 hoppers.
Serve with pol sambol or a curry.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan String Hoppers
recipes.summary: Steamed nests of fine rice-flour noodles, served with coconut sambol and dhal.
steps: Mix the rice flour and salt, then add the boiling water bit by bit and knead into a soft, smooth dough.
Brush a string hopper press or large piping bag with oil and fill it with dough.
Press out spirals onto oiled trays or mats.
Steam for 8 minutes, until firm and cooked through.
notes: Serve with dhal, coconut sambol and fish curry.
Makes about 20 string hoppers.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Lunu Miris Chilli and Onion Sambol
recipes.summary: A fiery red onion, chilli and lime pounded paste, traditionally eaten with hoppers and roti.
steps: Crush the chilli flakes, salt and sugar with a little onion in a mortar to a paste.
Add the rest of the onion and the lime juice and crush lightly.
Crush until the mixture is moist and well combined, then adjust the salt and lime.
notes: Eat the same day.
Serve with hoppers or roti.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Kiri Bath Milk Rice
recipes.summary: Creamy coconut milk rice cut into diamonds, a festive Sri Lankan breakfast served with lunu miris.
steps: Rinse the rice and cook with the water and salt for 15 minutes, until the water is absorbed.
Stir in the coconut milk and cook gently for 10 minutes, until the mixture is thick and creamy.
Press into a greased tray and smooth the top.
Cool for 15 minutes, then cut into diamonds.
notes: Serve with lunu miris or katta sambol.
Eat the same day.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Pittu Steamed Rice and Coconut
recipes.summary: Cylinders of steamed rice flour and fresh coconut, crumbly and soft, served with coconut milk and sambol.

items: 100g desiccated coconut, soaked in 3 tbsp warm water

steps: Dry-roast the rice flour in a pan for 5 minutes, until fragrant and no longer raw-smelling, then cool.
Mix with the salt and water, rubbing between your fingers until it forms damp crumbs that hold when squeezed.
Layer the crumbs with coconut in a pittu steamer or tall tin.
Steam for 10 minutes, until steam rises through the top layer.
notes: Serve with coconut milk gravy and pol sambol.
Do not add too much water or the pittu turns gummy.

recipes.title: Sri Lankan Mallung Greens with Coconut
recipes.summary: Finely shredded greens quickly stir-fried with fresh coconut, onion, turmeric and green chilli.
steps: Heat the oil and fry the onion, chillies and curry leaves for 3 minutes, until soft and golden.
Add the turmeric and silverbeet and cook for 3 minutes, until wilted.
Stir in the coconut and salt and cook for 2 minutes, until tender.
Finish with the lime juice.
notes: Serve with rice and curry.
Swap in kale or spinach.

recipes.title: Mexican Huevos a la Mexicana
recipes.summary: Scrambled eggs with tomato, onion, jalapeno and coriander in the colours of the Mexican flag.
steps: Whisk the eggs with the salt.
Fry the onion and jalapeno in the oil for 3 minutes, until soft.
Add the tomato and cook for 3 minutes, until the juices reduce.
Pour in the eggs and stir gently for 3 minutes, until just set.
Top with the coriander and serve with warm tortillas.
notes: Food safety: cook the eggs until fully set with no runny egg.
Serve with refried beans.

recipes.title: Mexican Molletes
recipes.summary: Open bolillo rolls spread with refried beans, topped with melted cheese and fresh pico de gallo.

items: 250g tinned black beans, drained and mashed

steps: Toast the roll halves under the grill for 2 minutes, until lightly golden.
Spread each with the mashed beans and top with the cheese.
Grill for 4 minutes, until the cheese melts and bubbles.
Mix the tomato, onion, jalapeno, coriander, lime juice and salt and spoon over the molletes.
notes: Serve straight away.
Add sliced avocado if you like.
